row.team_price_text: Standard: as low as $99/mo (Elastic Cloud Hosted, resource-based)
row.evidence: Elastic's Cloud SAML SSO guide says users are "automatically provisioned" on first SSO login but "Actions taken on the IdP are not automatically reflected in Elastic Cloud", and no SCIM page exists in the docs sitemap; organization SAML SSO for Cloud Hosted "Requires an Enterprise subscription".
row.notes: Changed from gated to none. June's 'SCIM typically Enterprise' has no first-party source: Elastic documents only SAML JIT provisioning with group-to-role mapping, and says removing a user in the IdP does not remove them or end their sessions. Elastic Cloud Hosted tiers (resource-based, 'as low as' per month, based on 120 GB storage / 2 zones): Standard $99, Gold $114, Platinum $131, Enterprise $184. Stack-level SSO (SAML, OIDC, Kerberos, JWT in Kibana/Elasticsearch) starts at Platinum; organization-level Elastic Cloud SAML SSO needs Enterprise on Hosted but is included on any Serverless tier. Members can be invited, listed and removed via the Elastic Cloud API with an API key on any tier.

plans.price_text: As low as $184 per month (Elastic Cloud Hosted)
plans.notes: Adds organization-level Elastic Cloud SAML SSO.

deprovision.notes: IdP removal does not remove the member or end sessions; an organization owner must remove the user or their roles.

scim.notes: Absence: the docs sitemap (9,907 URLs) has no SCIM page; the Cloud organization user docs cover only invitations, SAML JIT and role mappings.

auth.notes: Authorization: ApiKey header with an Elastic Cloud API key.

capabilities.notes: Users join by invitation (with role_assignments in the request body); delete = remove member from the organization.

okta.notes: Elastic documents registering Elastic Cloud SAML in Okta as a custom app; okta.com/integrations/elastic-cloud/, /elastic/ and /elasticsearch/ return 404.

entra.notes: Elastic's guide creates a new Entra ID Enterprise application for SAML; gallery listing not checked.

fallbacks.notes: Group-based role mappings apply at SSO login.
